1A.title: Nice to meet you
words: a word you say when you meet someone
a word you say when you leave
the first day of the working week
I am at home on Sunday.
You are at home on Sunday.

g.title: Verb be: I and you
g.rule:
Use am with I. Use are with you.

II am Anna. · I'm a student.
youYou are Tom. · You're a teacher.
questionAre you Tom? Yes, I am.
g.ru: Глагол be: I am (I'm) — «я есть», you are (you're) — «ты / вы есть». В вопросе are стоит первым: Are you Tom?

ex.q: ___ you a teacher? Yes, I am.

talk: Say hello. Say your name: Hello, I am…
Ask your partner: Are you a student?

r.text:
Hello! I am Dana. I am a student.

You are Tom. You are a teacher.

I am in room five. You are in room two.

Today is Monday. See you on Friday. Goodbye!

l.intro: Two people meet in a class.

script.t: Hello. I am Anelya.
Hello, Anelya. I am Manneh.
Are you a student?
No, I am a teacher. Are you a student?
Yes, I am.
Nice to meet you. See you on Monday!

1B.title: Music round the world
words: a place like Kazakhstan or Japan
a country in Europe; Madrid is there
страна в Европе, где находится Мадрид
a very big country in Asia
a country in Asia; Tokyo is there
страна в Азии, где находится Токио
a big country in South America
songs and sounds you listen to
песни и звуки, которые мы слушаем
a word to ask about a place

g.title: Verb be: he, she, it
g.rule:
Use is with he, she and it.

heHe is from Spain. · He's a singer.
sheShe is from China. · She's a teacher.
itIt is from Brazil. · It's a big country.
questionIs he from Japan? No, he isn't.
g.ru: С he, she, it используем is (he's, she's, it's). Отрицание: isn't. Вопрос: Is he…? Is she…?

talk: Talk about a singer: He is from… She is from…
Ask: Where is he from? Where is she from?

r.text:
This is Carlos. He is a singer. He is from Spain. Madrid is in Spain.

This is Aiko. She is a singer. She is from Japan.

This is the music. It is from Brazil. It is good!

l.intro: Two friends listen to music.

script.t: This music is good. Is it from Spain?
No, it isn't. It is from Brazil.
Is the singer from Brazil?
Yes, he is. He is from Rio.
Is Rio a big city?
Yes, it is. It is in Brazil.

2A.title: Are you on holiday?
words: days when you do not work
a place where you sleep on holiday
people you like and know well
люди, которых вы любите и хорошо знаете
a person on holiday in a new place
человек на отдыхе в новом месте

g.title: Verb be: we, you, they
g.rule:
Use are with we, you and they.

weWe are on holiday. · We're Kazakh.
theyThey are tourists. · They're Spanish.
negativeWe aren't English.
questionAre they on holiday? Yes, they are.
g.ru: С we, you, they используем are (we're, they're). Отрицание: aren't. Вопрос: Are they…?

talk: Talk about you and your friends: We are… We aren't…
Ask: Are you on holiday? Are they tourists?

r.text:
We are on holiday. We are in a hotel.

We are Kazakh. We are from Almaty.

They are our friends. They are Spanish. They are tourists.

We aren't at the airport. We are here, and we are happy.

l.intro: Two people meet in a hotel.

script.t: Hello. Are you tourists?
Yes, we are. We are on holiday.
Are you English?
No, we aren't. We are Spanish.
We are Kazakh. We are from Almaty.
Nice to meet you. This is a good hotel!

ex.q: Where are Pedro and his friends from?

2B.title: What number is the bus?
words: The hotel is a hundred dollars.
a big car for many people
It is the number ten bus.
a word to ask about a thing
a word to ask about the way

g.title: Wh- and How questions
g.rule:
Start a question with a question word. Then use is or are.

WhatWhat is your name?
WhereWhere are you from?
How oldHow old is he?
HowHow are you?
g.ru: Вопрос начинается с вопросительного слова: What (что, какой), Where (где, откуда), How old (сколько лет), How (как). Затем is или are.

talk: Ask your partner: What is your name? Where are you from? How old are you?
Ask for a phone number and an address.

r.text:
What is your name? My name is Aigul.

How old are you? I am twenty.

Where are you from? I am from Astana.

What is your phone number? It is 555 12 30.

What is your address? It is 11 Park Street.

l.intro: A woman asks a man for his details.

script.t: What is your name, please?
My name is Timur.
How old are you?
I am thirty.
What is your phone number?
Thank you. You are in room twelve.

lessons.title: Speaking: What number is the bus?

3A.title: Where's my phone?
words: a thing you use to call people
a small thing that opens a door
a thing for your books and things
вещь для книг и других предметов
a thing you use in the rain
an + a, e, i, o, u
a small clock on your arm
a thing you wear to see well
вещь, которую носят, чтобы лучше видеть
a small thing for your money
a thing you eat or work at
предмет, за которым едят или работают
The keys are on the table.
The pen is on the table.
The bag is on the chair.
The book is on the chair.

g.title: Singular and plural nouns, a / an
g.rule:
For one thing use a or an. For two or more, add -s.

a + b, c, d, f…a pen · a bag
an + a, e, i, o, uan umbrella · an apple
plural: + -stwo pens · three keys
plural: + -estwo watches · three boxes
g.ru: Один предмет: a (перед согласным) или an (перед гласным). Много предметов: + -s (pens) или -es (watches).

talk: What is in your bag? It is a… They are…
Point at things in the room and say the words.

r.text:
What is in my bag?

It is a pen. It is a book. It is an umbrella.

They are keys. They are glasses.

Where is my phone? It is on the table. Where is my wallet? It is on the chair.

ex.q: The wallet is on the chair.

l.intro: A man cannot find his things.

script.t: Mira, where is my phone?
It is on the table.
And where is my wallet?
It is in your bag.
What is this?
It is an umbrella. And they are your keys!

lessons.title: Singular and plural nouns, a / an

3B.title: Souvenirs
words: the thing there, not near me
предмет там, не рядом со мной
the things there, not near me
предметы там, не рядом со мной
a thing you buy on holiday
a card with a photo of a place
a thing you drink tea from
a thing you wear on your head
a picture of a city or country
a thing a child plays with
How much is + this / that + noun?

g.title: this / that / these / those
g.rule:
Use this and these for things near you. Use that and those for things not near you.

near, one thingThis is a cup.
near, two or moreThese are postcards.
not near, one thingThat is a hat.
not near, two or moreThose are T-shirts.
g.ru: This (этот) и these (эти) — предметы рядом. That (тот) и those (те) — предметы далеко. This / that — один предмет, these / those — много.

talk: You are in a souvenir shop. Ask: How much is this…? How much are those…?
Show three things: This is… These are…

r.text:
This is a souvenir shop.

This is a cup. These are postcards. They are five dollars.

That is a hat. Those are T-shirts. They are twenty dollars.

How much is this map? It is ten dollars. It is a good map!

l.intro: A tourist is in a souvenir shop.

script.t: Hello. How much is this cup?
It is five dollars.
And how much are these postcards?
They are two dollars.
What is that?
That is a hat. It is ten dollars.
The cup and two postcards, please.

4A.title: This is my family
words: a boy with the same parents as you
мальчик, у которого те же родители
a girl with the same parents as you
девочка, у которой те же родители
the man a woman is married to
the woman a man is married to
your mother, father, brothers and sisters
a young man or male child
a young woman or female child

g.title: Possessive adjectives, possessive 's
g.rule:
Say whose a thing or a person is.

I → my · you → yourMy mother · your father
he → his · she → herhis sister · her brother
we → our · they → theirour son · their daughter
name + 'sAnna's husband · Tom's wife
g.ru: Притяжательные слова: my (мой), your (твой), his (его), her (её), our (наш), their (их). Имя + 's: Anna's husband — муж Анны.

ex.q: This is Tom and this is ___ wife.
We have a son. ___ son is ten.

talk: Show a photo: This is my… His name is… Her name is…
Talk about a friend's family: This is Dana's…

r.text:
This is my family.

This is my mother. Her name is Gulnara. This is my father. His name is Bolat.

This is my sister. Her husband is Tom. Their son is ten.

These are our children. Our daughter is five.

ex.q: How old is the sister's son?

l.intro: A woman shows a photo.

script.t: This is my family.
Is this your husband?
Yes. His name is Marat.
And is this your daughter?
No, this is my sister. Her name is Dana.
Are these your children?
Yes. Our son is ten and our daughter is five.

4B.title: The right car for me

g.title: Adjectives
g.rule:
An adjective tells you about a thing. It goes before the noun, or after be.

before a nouna red car · a big house
after beThe car is new.
no -stwo red cars (not reds)
g.ru: Прилагательное стоит перед существительным (a red car) или после be (The car is new). Оно не изменяется: two red cars.

talk: Talk about a car: It is… It is a… car.
Talk about three things you have: My phone is…

r.text:
This is my car. It is a small car. It is old, and it is red. It is slow, but it is cheap.

That is my brother's car. It is a big car. It is new, and it is black. It is fast, but it is expensive.

My car is good for me!

ex.q: What colour is the writer's car?

l.intro: A man looks at a car in a shop.

script.t: Hello. Is this a new car?
Yes, it is. It is a fast car.
Is it expensive?
No, it isn't. It is cheap.
Is it big?
No, it is a small car. It is red or blue.
The blue car is good!

ex.q: What colour does the man like?

lessons.title: Speaking: The right car for me

5A.title: My favourite meal
words: an animal from the sea that we eat
a hot black or brown drink
the food you eat in the morning

g.title: Present simple (+ and –): I, you, we, they
g.rule:
Use the present simple for things you do every day.

positiveI eat bread. · We drink tea.
negative: don't + verbI don't eat meat. · They don't drink coffee.
g.ru: Present simple — то, что вы делаете обычно. С I, you, we, they глагол без изменений: I eat. Отрицание: don't + глагол.

talk: Talk about your food: I eat… I don't eat… I drink…
Talk about breakfast in your family: We have…

r.text:
My favourite meal is breakfast.

I eat bread and cheese. I have eggs. I drink tea.

I don't eat meat in the morning. I don't drink coffee.

My children eat fruit. They drink water. We like breakfast!

ex.q: The writer eats meat in the morning.

l.intro: Two friends talk about food.

script.t: Arman, do you eat meat?
No, I don't. I eat fish and vegetables.
I eat meat. I don't eat fish.
I drink tea in the morning.
I drink coffee. I don't like tea.
We like fruit!

lessons.title: Present simple (+ and –): I, you, we, they

5B.title: A very long flight
words: look at words in a book
look at a film or TV
close your eyes and rest at night
Do you sleep on a plane?
have your home in a place
a thing that flies in the sky

g.title: Present simple (?): I, you, we, they
g.rule:
Make a question with Do.

questionDo you read books?
short answersYes, I do. · No, I don't.
with a question wordWhat do you read? · Where do they live?
g.ru: Вопрос в present simple: Do + you / we / they + глагол? Краткий ответ: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

ex.q: Do you watch films? Yes, I ___.

talk: Ask your partner five questions: Do you…?
Ask: What do you do on a plane?

r.text:
It is a long flight. What do you do on a plane?

Do you read? Yes, I do. I read a book.

Do you watch films? Yes, I do.

Do you sleep? No, I don't. I listen to music.

Do you work? No, I don't!

ex.q: The writer sleeps on the plane.
What does the writer listen to?

l.intro: Two people talk on a plane.

script.t: It is a long flight. Do you sleep on planes?
No, I don't. I read.
Do you watch films?
Yes, I do. Do you?
No, I don't. I listen to music.
Do you want tea?
Yes, I do. Thank you.

lessons.title: Present simple (?): I, you, we, they

6A.title: Old friends?
words: a person who helps ill people
a person who helps a doctor
a person who brings food in a café
человек, который приносит еду в кафе
a person who drives a car or bus
человек, который водит машину или автобус
a person who works in a shop

место, где люди работают за столами
a place where people make things
a person you like and know well
человек, которого вы любите и хорошо знаете

g.title: Present simple: he, she, it
g.rule:
With he, she and it, add -s to the verb.

positiveHe works in a bank. · She likes her job.
negative: doesn't + verbShe doesn't work in an office.
question: Does + verbDoes he work here? Yes, he does.
spellinggo → goes · have → has · teach → teaches
g.ru: С he, she, it к глаголу добавляем -s: he works. Отрицание: doesn't + глагол. Вопрос: Does he…? Исключения: goes, has.

talk: Talk about a friend: He works in… She doesn't…
Ask about a friend's job: Does he…? Where does she…?

r.text:
Aliya is my old friend. She is a doctor. She works in a hospital.

She likes her job. She doesn't work on Sunday.

Her husband is a waiter. He works in a restaurant. He doesn't like his job.

Does Aliya drive? Yes, she does. She has a small car.

l.intro: Two friends talk about a friend.

script.t: Zara, does your friend work?
Yes, she does. She is a nurse.
Does she work in a hospital?
Yes, she does. She likes her job.
Does her husband work?
Yes. He drives a bus. He doesn't like it.

6B.title: Good morning, goodnight
words: leave your bed in the morning
I always get up at seven.
I go to work at eight.
She goes to work at nine.
eat in the middle of the day
I usually have lunch at one.
We always have dinner at seven.
I never go to bed late.
I never go to bed early.
the first part of the day
I get up in the morning.
the last part of the day
I watch TV in the evening.

g.title: Adverbs of frequency
g.rule:
Say how often you do something.

100%I always have breakfast.
80%I usually get up at seven.
40%I sometimes watch TV.
0%I never go to bed late.
g.ru: Always (всегда), usually (обычно), sometimes (иногда), never (никогда) стоят перед глаголом: I always have breakfast.

talk: Talk about your day: I always… I usually… I never…
Ask your partner: What time do you usually get up?

r.text:
I always get up at seven. I usually have a shower. I go to work at eight.

I usually have lunch at one. I go home at six.

We always have dinner at seven. I sometimes watch TV in the evening.

I never go to bed late.

ex.q: What time does the writer get up?
The writer goes to bed late.

l.intro: A woman asks a man about his day.

script.t: Max, what time do you get up?
I always get up at six.
Six! Do you have breakfast?
I usually have tea. I never have coffee.
What do you do in the evening?
I sometimes watch TV. I go to bed at ten.

ex.q: What time does Max get up?
What time does he go to bed?

words: go to shops and buy things
ходить в магазины и покупать вещи

do the sport with a ball
run, swim or play a game
I do sport at the weekend.

идти к человеку или в какое-то место

a green place in a city
a word to ask about time

g.title: Word order in questions
g.rule:
The order is: question word, do, subject, verb.

with doWhat do you do at the weekend?
Where / WhenWhere do you go? · When do you get up?
with beWhere are you from?
g.ru: Порядок слов в вопросе: вопросительное слово + do + подлежащее + глагол: What do you do? С глаголом be: Where are you from?

ex.q: What ___ you do at the weekend?

talk: Ask your partner: What do you do at the weekend?
Ask three questions with Where, When and Who.

r.text:
What do you do at the weekend?

On Saturday I go shopping. I meet friends in the park. We play football.

On Sunday I stay at home. I cook. I clean my room.

When do I visit my grandmother? On Sunday evening. Where does she live? In a small house.

ex.q: What does the writer do on Saturday?
When does the writer visit the grandmother?
They play football in the park.

l.intro: Two colleagues talk on Friday.

script.t: Dina, what do you do at the weekend?
I go shopping on Saturday.
Where do you go?
I go to the big shop in the city.
When do you meet friends?
On Sunday. We go to the cinema.
I stay at home and cook!

ex.q: What does Dina do on Saturday?

lessons.title: Listening: What do you do at the weekend?

g.title: Imperatives, object pronouns
g.rule:
Use the verb alone to tell someone to do something. After a verb, use me, him, her, it, us, them.

positiveOpen the door. · Look at the camera.
negativeDon't stop. · Don't watch it.
object pronounsHelp me. · Tell him. · Watch it. · Call them.
g.ru: Повелительное наклонение: глагол без to — Open the door. Отрицание: Don't + глагол. После глагола: me, him, her, it, us, them.

ex.q: That is Anna. Do you know ___?
___ (not / watch) that film. It is bad.

talk: Give your partner five instructions: Open… Close… Don't…
Talk about films: I like it. I don't like them.

r.text:
It is film night. Sit down!

This is a comedy. Watch it. It is good.

This is a horror film. Don't watch it at night!

My brother likes action films. I don't like them. My children love cartoons.

Close the door. Don't talk. Look!

l.intro: A man takes a photo of a family.

script.t: Stand here, please. Look at the camera.
Children, look at him!
Don't talk, please. Smile!
Tom, stop that. Help me.
Good. Don't close your eyes.
Tell us when.
Now! Thank you.

ex.q: Who does the mother talk to?

8A.title: Can I park here?
words: stop your car in a place
make a picture with a camera

My car is in the car park.

g.title: can / can't
g.rule:
Use can to say what is possible or what you are able to do.

positiveI can drive. · You can park here.
negativeI can't swim. · You can't park here.
questionCan I sit here? Yes, you can.
g.ru: Can + глагол без to: I can drive. Отрицание: can't. Вопрос: Can I…? Can you…?

talk: What can you do? What can't you do?
Ask for permission: Can I…? Can I…?

r.text:
You can do a lot in my city.

You can park in the car park. You can't park in the street.

You can ride a bike in the park. You can swim in the river.

Can you pay by card? Yes, you can. Can you take a photo in the museum? No, you can't.

ex.q: You can take a photo in the museum.

l.intro: A driver talks to a police officer.

script.t: Excuse me. Can I park here?
No, you can't. You can park in the car park.
Can I pay by card?
Yes, you can.
Can I take a photo of the park?
Yes, you can. It is a nice park.

ex.q: She can park in the street.
What can she take a photo of?

words: going to shops and buying things

Do you like cooking?

I don't like cooking. I like dancing.

talk: Look at the people in the room. What are they doing?

lessons.title: Speaking: What are they really doing?

There is a lamp on the table.
There is a book on the table.
what you can see from a window
There is a view of the sea.
The bag is in the room.
The keys are in the bag.
touching the top of a thing
The phone is on the bed.
The lamp is on the table.
The shoes are under the bed.
The bag is under the chair.

g.title: there's a… / there are some…
g.rule:
Use these to say what is in a place.

one thingThere's a bed in the room.
two or moreThere are two windows. · There are some towels.
questionIs there a shower? Yes, there is.
g.ru: There is (there's) + один предмет, there are + много предметов. Вопрос: Is there a…?

ex.q: There ___ some towels in the bathroom.

talk: Describe your room: There's a… There are some…
Ask about a hotel room: Is there a…?

r.text:
This is my hotel room.

There is a big bed. There is a table and there is a lamp on the table.

There are two windows. There is a nice view.

There is a bathroom. There is a shower and there are some towels.

My bag is under the bed.

ex.q: The bag is on the bed.

l.intro: A guest asks about a hotel room.

script.t: Hello. Is there a room for one?
Yes, there is. There is a big bed.
Is there a bathroom?
Yes, there is a bathroom with a shower.
Are there towels?
Yes, there are some towels. And there is a nice view.

lessons.title: Speaking: A room with a view

10B.title: Where was he?
words: in the place where you work
in the place where you learn
in a place where you drink coffee
in a green place in the city
not working, in a new place
the past of am and is

g.title: Past simple: be
g.rule:
The past of am / is is was. The past of are is were.

I / he / she / itI was at home. · She was at work.
you / we / theyWe were in a café.
negativeHe wasn't at school. · They weren't at home.
questionWhere were you? · Was he at work?
g.ru: Прошедшее время be: I / he / she / it was; you / we / they were. Отрицание: wasn't, weren't. Вопрос: Where were you?

talk: Where were you yesterday at eight? And last night?
Ask your partner: Where were you on Sunday?

r.text:
Where was everybody yesterday?

I was at home. My father was at work. My mother was in a café.

My brothers were at school. My grandparents were in the park.

My sister wasn't at home. She was on holiday. And the cat? It was in bed!

l.intro: A man asks his friend about yesterday.

script.t: Kate, where were you yesterday?
I was at work.
Were you at work in the evening?
No, I wasn't. I was in a café.
Was Dana in the café?
No, she wasn't. She was at home.
I was in the park. It was nice!

ex.q: Where was Kate in the evening?

11A.title: A new life in the USA
words: have your home in a place
go and live in a new place
I moved here two years ago.

g.title: Past simple: regular verbs
g.rule:
For the past, add -ed to the verb.

positiveI worked in a shop. · She lived in Almaty.
negative: didn't + verbHe didn't work on Sunday.
question: Did + verbDid you live in London?
spellinglive → lived · study → studied · stop → stopped
g.ru: Past simple: к глаголу добавляем -ed: worked, lived. Отрицание: didn't + глагол. Вопрос: Did you + глагол?

talk: Talk about your life: I lived in… I worked in… I studied…
Ask your partner: Did you…?

r.text:
My grandfather lived in a small village.

In 1990 he moved to a big city. He wanted a new life.

He arrived by train. He stayed in a hotel. Then he worked in a factory.

He studied in the evening. He finished in 1995. He started a new job.

ex.q: When did he move to the city?

l.intro: A student asks a teacher about his life.

script.t: Did you live in London?
Yes, I lived in London.
When did you move here?
I moved here two years ago.
Did you work in a school in London?
No, I worked in a bank. Then I studied.
And now you are a teacher!

ex.q: He worked in a school in London.

lessons.title: Speaking: A new life in the USA

11B.title: How was your day?
words: I went to work by bus.
go to shops and buy things
I went to bed at eleven.
the time from morning to night

g.title: Past simple: irregular verbs get, go, have, do
g.rule:
Some verbs do not take -ed. Learn their past forms.

get → gotI got up at seven.
go → wentI went to work.
have → hadI had lunch at one.
do → didI did my homework.
negative and questionI didn't go. · Did you have lunch?
g.ru: Неправильные глаголы: get → got, go → went, have → had, do → did. После didn't и Did — первая форма: I didn't go.

talk: Talk about yesterday: I got up at… I went to… I had…
Ask your partner: How was your day?

r.text:
I had a good day.

I got up at seven. I had a shower. I had breakfast.

I went to work by bus. I had lunch at one.

I got home at six. I did the shopping. I went to bed at ten. I was tired!

ex.q: How did the writer go to work?
What time did the writer get home?
The writer had a bad day.

l.intro: A husband and wife talk in the evening.

script.t: How was your day?
It was good. I got up at six and I went to work.
Did you have lunch?
Yes, I had lunch at one.
I went shopping and I did my homework.
Did you have a good day?
Yes, but I am tired!

ex.q: What time did Bolat get up?

lessons.title: Past simple: irregular verbs get, go, have, do

12A.title: Strangers on a train
words: I saw a man on the train.
see and talk to a person
видеть человека и говорить с ним
I met a woman on the train.
a long thing that travels on a railway
a paper you buy to travel
I bought a ticket to Almaty.
a person you do not know

g.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs
g.rule:
Use regular and irregular verbs together to tell a story.

regularI talked to a man. · He opened the window.
irregularsee → saw · meet → met · say → said · buy → bought · sit → sat · leave → left
negative and questionI didn't see him. · Did you buy a ticket?
g.ru: В рассказе о прошлом используем правильные (talked) и неправильные глаголы: saw, met, said, bought, sat, left.

ex.q: I ___ a woman on the train.

talk: Tell a short story: Yesterday I went… I saw… I met…
Ask your partner about a trip: Where did you go?

r.text:
Last week I travelled by train.

I bought a ticket and I sat next to a window. A woman sat next to me.

She said hello. We talked for an hour. She asked my name.

The train arrived. She left. Then I saw her bag. I opened the door, but she wasn't there.

l.intro: A woman tells a friend about her trip.

script.t: How was your trip?
It was good. I met a man on the train.
Did you talk?
Yes. He sat next to me and he said hello.
What did you talk about?
He asked my name. Then he bought me a tea.
And then?
The train arrived, and he left.

ex.q: Where did Aigerim meet the man?

lessons.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs

12B.title: Revise the past
words: I was at home last week.
a time when people eat, drink and dance
время, когда люди едят, пьют и танцуют
a journey to a place and back
I had dinner. Then I went to bed.

g.title: Past simple revision
g.rule:
Three things to remember about the past.

beI was late. · We were happy.
other verbsI worked. · I went. · I had a party.
negative and questionI didn't go. · Did you go? · Were you late?
g.ru: Повторение: be → was / were. Другие глаголы: + -ed или особая форма (went, had). Отрицание: didn't + глагол. Вопрос: Did you…?

talk: Talk about last year: I was… I went… I didn't…
Ask your partner five questions about last week.

r.text:
Last year was a good year.

I was born in a village, but last year I moved to the city. I started a new job.

I met new friends. We went to a party in the summer. We were happy.

I didn't have a trip. But then, in 2020, I didn't have a job!

ex.q: When did they go to a party?
The writer had a trip last year.

l.intro: Two friends talk about last year.

script.t: Chris, was last year good?
Yes, it was. I started a new job.
Did you have a trip?
No, I didn't. I was at work.
I went to a party in the summer.
Were you happy?
Yes, I was. I met my husband there!

ex.q: Chris had a trip last year.
Who did Dina meet at the party?
